from scripts.document import Document

HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

for text in HEADLINES:
    node = editor.get_node(tag="w:r", contains=text)
    if node is None:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {text}")
        continue
    rprs = node.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
    if rprs.length:
        rpr = rprs[0]
    else:
        rpr = editor.dom.createElement("w:rPr")
        node.insertBefore(rpr, node.firstChild)
    us = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
    if us.length:
        us[0].setAttribute("w:val", "single")
    else:
        u = editor.dom.createElement("w:u")
        u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
        rpr.appendChild(u)
    print(f"OK: {text}")

doc.save()
print("Saved.")

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import DocxXMLEditor

HEADLINES = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

editor = DocxXMLEditor('unpacked/word/document.xml', rsid="00000000")

all_ok = True
for text in HEADLINES:
    node = editor.get_node(tag="w:r", contains=text)
    rprs = node.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
    us = rprs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u") if rprs.length else []
    val = us[0].getAttribute("w:val") if us.length else None
    ok = val == "single"
    all_ok = all_ok and ok
    print(f"{'OK ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {text} -> w:u val={val}")

# Sanity: body paragraphs must NOT be underlined
body_checks = [
    "The fourth quarter of 2024",
    "Customer acquisition costs",
    "Total operating expenses",
    "Looking ahead to Q1 2025",
    "Key risks include",
]
for text in body_checks:
    node = editor.get_node(tag="w:r", contains=text)
    rprs = node.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
    us = rprs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:u") if rprs.length else []
    if us.length:
        print(f"FAIL body text underlined: {text[:30]}...")
        all_ok = False
    else:
        print(f"OK  body text not underlined: {text[:30]}...")

print("ALL OK" if all_ok else "ISSUES FOUND")

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx') as z:
    xml = z.read('word/document.xml').decode('ascii')

headlines = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

count = 0
for h in headlines:
    # find the run containing this headline and check it has w:u single
    idx = xml.find(f'<w:t xml:space="preserve">{h}</w:t>')
    if idx == -1:
        print(f"FAIL text missing: {h}")
        continue
    run_start = xml.rfind('<w:r>', 0, idx)
    run_end = xml.find('</w:r>', idx) + len('</w:r>')
    run = xml[run_start:run_end]
    if '<w:u w:val="single"/>' in run:
        print(f"OK  {h}")
        count += 1
    else:
        print(f"FAIL no underline in run: {h}")

print(f"{count}/{len(headlines)} headlines underlined in packed docx")
